subject: Post-call: Live audit traceability, retention windows, and DPA alignment for Finova
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finova.com>; Maya Gupta <m.gupta@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + asks from today's demo

Thanks for the demo earlier — appreciate the clear walkthrough. A very quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can align with our InfoSec/legal review: 

1) In-scope controls: SOC 2 is a blocker for us — we need to understand your current SOC 2 scope (CC1-CC7 coverage) and the date of the last report.
2) Audit log granularity: we need live/auditable traces for API requests (request_id, timestamp, model, tokens consumed, user_id, redaction flag) and the ability to stream those logs to our SIEM.
3) Retention: Our policy requires 7 years for certain payment-related telemetry and 90 days for other application-level payloads — can Redwood support per-log retention policies and legal holds?
4) DPA specifics: we have a few non-standard clauses (data localization and subprocessor notification windows) — our GC (Laura) will share redlines.
5) Pen test: We will want to coordinate an annual pen-test or get evidence of a recent one.

Next steps we need from Redwood: a one-pager of what artifacts you can provide (SOC 2 type 2, pen-test summary, audit log schema), a proposed timeline for evidence delivery, and who on your side will be the intake contact for secure uploads.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Security, Finova Capital
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@finova.com>, Maya Gupta <m.gupta@finova.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today's demo

Hi Samir / Laura / Maya —

Thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise mapping of what we discussed and proposed next steps. I copied our internal owners (Marissa for integration/architecture, Neha for compliance intake).

Summary of asks (mapped to Redwood capabilities)
- SOC 2: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II (in-scope: availability, confidentiality, processing integrity, security). Latest report date: 2026-05-17. We can provide a redacted copy under NDA. (Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
- Audit logs / live tracing: We support structured audit logs including request_id, timestamp (ISO8601), model_name, latency, token_counts, user_id (customer-provided ID), action flags (redacted/masked). We can stream logs via a secure forwarder to your SIEM (syslog/HTTPS/CloudWatch). See attached schema (audit-log-schema.csv).
- Retention & legal holds: Retention policies are configurable per-log stream on Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted API we offer configurable retention tiers (30/90/365/1825 days) plus support for legal hold that extends retention until release. We'll confirm whether 7-year retention is available on your planned plan — likely on Dedicated or Private.
- DPA & localization: We can accept targeted DPA redlines; however, data localization requirements typically map to Private/VPC deployments or region-specific hosting. Link to proposed redline: https://redwood.app/legal/redlines/finova-dpa-v1
- Pen test evidence: We have a recent third-party pen-test summary (2026-04) and an internal security program we can summarize.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) Finova to upload initial DDQ + redline requests to our secure intake (link below).
2) Redwood to provide redacted SOC 2 and pen-test executive summary within 3 business days of completed NDA.
3) Marissa to schedule a short technical sync to review log formats, ingestion, and retention options — propose Wed 9/3 or Thu 9/4.
4) Neha to own evidence intake and provide an itemized checklist + timelines.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, audit-log-schema.csv
Secure upload: https://drive.google.com/finova-secure-upload

If that looks good I'll get the calendar invite out and Marissa will prepare a technical playbook for the call.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Exec — Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>; Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>; Laura Chen <laura.chen@finova.com>; Maya Gupta <m.gupta@finova.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today's demo

Samir — quick technical notes before our sync:

- Log payloads: by default we do NOT persist full unredacted user prompts in Hosted mode unless customers opt in; we capture metadata and a redaction flag. On Dedicated/Private we can offer scoped retention and full payload retention per contract.
- SIEM integration: we can provide an HTTPS forwarder or a lightweight agent; if you need a raw Kinesis/GCP PubSub sink that is available on Dedicated.
- Token accounting: our runtime emits per-token cost and per-batch summaries; we can tag tokens with purpose labels to help with retention classification.

Inline on Avery's steps: 1) Agreed — please upload the DDQ and Laura's redlines. 2) We'll have the redacted SOC 2 + pen-test summary ready once legal confirms the NDA. 3) For the technical sync, I'll prepare a short checklist (network/IP allowlist, expected qps, sample events) and a minimal schema sample so we can validate SIEM ingestion during the call.

Proposed times for the technical sync (Pacific time):
- Wed 9/3 10:00am - 10:30am PT
- Thu 9/4 2:00pm - 2:30pm PT

If either of those works I'll drop a calendar invite with a short agenda.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>; Laura Chen <laura.chen@finova.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Maya Gupta <m.gupta@finova.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today's demo

Hi Samir / Laura —

Thanks — I'm taking point on the evidence intake and can act as your primary contact for compliance artifacts. A short intake checklist and timeline below (feel free to upload via the secure link Avery included):

Compliance intake checklist (requested items)
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — requested within 3 business days after NDA.
- Pen-test executive summary (PDF) and date of last full test.
- Audit log sample (CSV) showing the fields we discussed (request_id, timestamp, model, user_id, redaction_flag, token_counts). If you cannot share real data, provide a synthetically redacted sample.
- Current DDQ / security questionnaire answers (XLSX) — upload latest.
- Specific DPA clauses you want redlined (Word/Docx).

Timeline (target)
- Day 0: Finova uploads artifacts to secure intake.
- Day 1-3: Redwood legal/security reviews SOC 2 and DDQ; provide questions and a redline response for DPA.
- Day 4-7: Technical sync + SIEM ingestion test with sample events.

Notes on retention: Hosted plan supports retention tiers up to 1825 days (5 years) and legal hold; 7-year retention is supported on Dedicated and Private deployments subject to contractual commitment and storage sizing. We'll include a cost estimate in the follow-up.

I'll also propose a draft intake ticket in our compliance tracker once the files are uploaded. If Laura wants to push redlines sooner, please send them and I'll flag any tough points before legal reviews.

Secure intake: https://drive.google.com/finova-secure-upload
DPA redline link (working): https://redwood.app/legal/redlines/finova-dpa-v1

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Security & Compliance Operations — Redwood Inference
